TIFA_CHI.title: Chi Level
TIFA_CHI.description:
Gain 1 [gold]Chi[/gold] whenever you reach 5 [gold]Combo[/gold]. 
Combo is primarily gained by playing Attacks.

Level 1: Gain 1 Strength.
Level 2: Attacks gain 1 additional Combo.
Level 3: Gain 1 Dexterity.
Level 4: Gain double Limit from attacks.
Level 5: Draw 1 additional card at the start of your turn.
Level 6: Gain 1 Strength and 1 Dexterity.
Level 7: Gain 1 additional Energy each turn.
Level 8: Gain 1 Strength and 1 Dexterity.
TIFA_LIMIT.title: Limit Break
TIFA_LIMIT.description:
At 100 [gold]Limit[/gold], Tifa can perform [gold]Limit Break[/gold]. 

Gain 5 Limit at the start of each turn, and whenever your Chi level increases. 
Gain 3 Limit whenever you play an Attack. 

Any remaining Combo at the end of combat is converted into Limit.
TIFA_COMBO.title: Combo Counter
TIFA_COMBO.description:
Gain Combo from Attacks. Every 5 Combo increases your [gold]Chi[/gold] Level by 1. 
If Combo is not increased during your turn, [gold]20%[/gold] of it decays at the end of the turn. 
Remaining Combo at the end of combat is converted into [gold]Limit[/gold].
